# isValidSheetId

<link-summary>Checks whether a value is a sheet id.</link-summary>

<web-summary>isValidSheetId() — Checks whether a value is a sheet id. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.5.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function isValidSheetId(value: unknown): value is number;
```

Apps Script numbers its sheets from zero, so a sheet id is a non-negative safe integer — the same rule `isCountable` applies. The id of the first sheet in a spreadsheet is `0`.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description         |
| :-------- | :-------- | :------------------ |
| `value`   | `unknown` | The value to check. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the value is a sheet id; otherwise `false`.

In TypeScript the guard narrows `value` to `number` inside the branch.

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
isValidSheetId(0); // => true
isValidSheetId(1234567890); // => true
isValidSheetId(-1); // => false
isValidSheetId(1.5); // => false
isValidSheetId("0"); // => false
```
